          Why Fly to North America

          Explore vibrant metropolises, vast natural wonders, and iconic coastlines across North America. Fly in supreme comfort while experiencing warm hospitality on your journey. Discover bustling cityscapes, world-class entertainment, and unforgettable landscapes from coast to coast. Whether traveling for business or embarking on a family adventure, North America promises endless possibilities. Book your journey today and step into a world of limitless opportunities and inspiring discovery.

          Popular North America Destinations

          01

          Experience New York City

          Walk through iconic urban parks, dynamic cultural centers, and world-class museum districts. Catch a spectacular Broadway performance, admire soaring skyscrapers, and sample incredible global culinary offerings in this legendary global metropolis.

          02

          Discover Washington D.C.

          Explore historic national monuments, expansive public green spaces, and renowned educational museums. Take engaging walking tours through charming historic neighborhoods and experience dynamic civic history first-hand.

          03

          Enjoy Sunny Los Angeles

          Relax along famous Pacific beaches and tour legendary entertainment studios. Experience vibrant coastal dining, active scenic hikes in nearby hills, and lively outdoor shopping districts bathed in year-round sunshine.

          04

          Explore Toronto Waterfront

          Discover diverse neighborhoods filled with creative art galleries and picturesque waterfront views. Experience thrilling panoramas from iconic observation towers and enjoy exceptional culinary experiences in Canada's largest cultural hub.

          05

          Visit Historic Boston

          Stroll along famous historic trails connecting iconic sites from American history. Enjoy peaceful public gardens, world-class educational institutions, and fresh local seafood along the scenic harbor waterfront.

          FAQs

          Traveling to North America

          Make planning your North America trip as enjoyable as the vacation itself. Read our answers to common questions and prepare for the perfect island escape.

          How far in advance should I book my flight to North America?

          The best time to book a flight to North America is 3 - 6 months before your date of travel. This would give you the best chance of finding the best prices and timings that fit your schedule.

          Can I change or cancel my flight to North America?

          Yes, we offer free cancellation on flights to North America subject to our cancellation and refund policy. Read our cancellation and refund policy for more information.

          Can I get extra baggage allowance for flights to North America?

          If our standard baggage allowance is not enough, you can add extra baggage to your flight booking at an additional fee. Read more about our additional baggage charges .
